issues.description: SQL projection mismatch: The solution query in solution_repository/aufgabe08.sql (line 1) uses SELECT * and thus returns all columns from Gemeinde, while the problem statement explicitly instructs students to "Gib immer genau die geforderten Daten aus und nicht mehr." (problem_statement.md lines 101-103) The task (Aufgabe 08) requests exactly the columns: name, kreis (Landkreis), flaeche and the Einwohnerzahlen (einwohner_m, einwohner_w). The solution's use of SELECT * contradicts the stated requirement, may mislead students about which columns to select, and can cause automated equivalence checks to behave unexpectedly.
issues.suggestedFix: Replace the SELECT * in solution_repository/aufgabe08.sql with an explicit projection of the required columns to match the problem statement. For example: SELECT name, kreis, flaeche, einwohner_m, einwohner_w FROM Gemeinde WHERE (einwohner_m > 50000 AND einwohner_w > 50000) OR flaeche > 100; This returns exactly the requested columns and aligns the solution with the exercise instructions.
